translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

book.name: LOMA
book.title: Folo yana leta LOMA tovetumagana agaidiya

content: Folo yana yoꞋo higa miIsileli Yesu hikilowena faꞋina,
ginuwavita lakahina.

Siule tobohiyakweyao, yaku nuwanuwa saꞋeyana ganalukahihiyena. Iya Keliso yana kaliva yaku gahe velemoꞋena. Keke gadafwaya. Kadu AluꞋaluwa Mahalina Tauna nuwahinagekuya gimimiyami-ma giꞋalakakila be iya makewa gagahe velemoꞋena ma nuwakuya gaꞋayaunena.

Gagahe velemoꞋena badi tobohiyakweyao higa tauku yaku yoꞋo kalivai-dina faꞋidiya ganuwanuwavita, ada yaku aseꞋuꞋaulolo keke maꞋita gidahavaini. Badi yaku yoꞋo kalivadi Yesu hikilowena faꞋina, aimo adi matahiwadi lakahina hinavaina be Keliso ginalugolohidi-yo abaga koyona againe hinamiyami. Tu kaꞋi iya tauku akufaiweya digo, adi matahiwadi iya gadavaina be Keliso gidalugolohiku-yo badi Yaubada buye hidamiyami hagihagina.

Badi kalivai-dina adi egana miIsileli. Yadi yamumu tulina tulina ganalukahihiyena. Tuwai-moꞋena Yaubada bwanenediyao giluwafadi be Tauna yana yoꞋo gisedi ada gigahedi gigayo, “OmiꞋiyao be bwanenemiyao ganahawavenatunemi.” Badi agaidiya yana veyao gisedi. Badi agaidiya yana vehimeya gilakayemu. Badi Yaubada ana tafalolo velemoꞋena hihalamanena ada manuwa-tafalolo againe Yaubada yana mahalina veꞋakinamanamalina giseyemaunena be hiꞋitana. Badi Yaubada yana wonadabadaba yadi miya hagihagina faꞋina hivaina.

Kaliva kikaiwabudiyao Abelahamo Aisake Isileli (kadu ana egana Yakobu) badi agaidiya hitubuyemu, kadu Bana Yaubada yana Tovegida Keliso babiya gihobuꞋela ana toveya badi yoꞋoi-dina agaidiya gitubuyemu, BanaꞋe anafaiweya Yaubada gaitoma moyaꞋaidi givehimeyedi-ma kalivai-nadi. Bana ana egana kanakilakahina tova inaga inaga keke ana abalauyabu. Ehe hidedemi.
Folo Yaubada yana lauwafa faꞋina gilukahihi.

Tu yaku yoꞋo kalivadi Yesu hikilowena ma kahihidi gayakahina faꞋina, keke vaita gadagahe higa Yaubada yana wonadabadaba miIsileli agaimeya keke gidalakayemu. Au gilakayemu faꞋina keke kaliva matatabudi bana kaliva kikaiwabuna ana egana Isileli againe hitubuyemu-ma Yaubada yana yoꞋo velemoꞋena kalivadi. Au tufoidiga, higa keke tokilowa au tovetumagana.

Kadu bana Abelahamo bwaneneneyao ma keke matatabudi Yaubada yana yoꞋo velemoꞋena kalivadi. FaꞋina tuwai-moꞋena Yaubada keke Abelahamo natuneyao moyaꞋaidi faꞋidiya gidagahe au bana Aisake anakaibe faꞋine gigahe gigayo,

content.text: Bana natu Aisake kadu bwaneneneyao agaidiya a egana ginayemuyemu.

content: Mena gahe ana nuwanuwa ma keke Abelahamo natuneyao moyaꞋaidi bana hagaline hitubuyemu-ma Yaubada yana yoꞋo kalivadi. Yaubada Abelahamo natuna saꞋeyanaga higa Aisake faꞋine bana againe giwonadabadaba. Gaveyao Yaubada yana wonadabadaba guwana againe hitubuyemu, medema Yaubada yana yoꞋo kalivadi.
Yana wonadabadaba ana gahegahe ma hidede amine. Gigayo,

content.text: Tova gayakahina-ma againe ganayewaꞋela be Sela natuna kaliva ginavenatunena.

content: Au hidedemi Yaubada Aisake faꞋine giwonadabadaba be yana lauwafa giseyemaunena.
KaduꞋe yana lauwafa ana abaꞋita saꞋeyana ma natuluga Libeka hivenatunedi, tomoꞋainagona ana egana Iso kadu kwamaneya ana egana Yakobu. Badi natuluga tamadi au saꞋeyana bana bwaneneda Aisake.
Atu weꞋoweꞋo adiꞋiselu aimo keke hidatubuga kadu aimo keke dewa hagihagina o dewa koyona hidafaisewani tu Yaubada kwamayoku agaidiya gigahe gigayo,

Yaubada hidedemi gigahe be higa yana lauwafa inubana ginaseyemaunena faꞋina. Natuluga aimo keke hidatubuga tu Tauna yana nuwenuweya kwamaneya giluwafana tu tomoꞋainagona keke gidaluwafani. Yana lauwafa inubana ma keke kaliva yana dewa gidaꞋitaluveluveni-yo gidaluwafani, au Tauna yana nuwenuweya giluwafana.
Meda anafaiweya Yaubada kaliva adiꞋiselu adi lauwafa faꞋina Veyao Tuwaina ana bukiya gigahe gigayo,

content.text: Bana Yakobu galuwafana tu bana Iso gakilowena.

content: Hida kagahe vaita Yaubada kaliva saꞋeyana giluwafana tu saꞋeyana gikilowena. Gavaimi kananuwanuwa? KaꞋi kanagahe vaita Yaubada keke kaliva tunutunugina? Keke, keke-moꞋa!
FaꞋina tuwai-moꞋena Yaubada Mosese againe gigahe gigayo,
Au hidedemi Yaubada Veyao Tuwaina ana bukiya gigahe.
Medema faꞋina kahalamanena Yaubada yana lauwafa inubana keke kaliva yana nuwanuwa o yana dewa, au Yaubada yana hinekalikali.
FaꞋina Yaubada yana gahe saꞋeyana Felo againe Veyao Tuwaina ana bukiya gidadauda gigayo,

content.text: Iya gakilakahi be miIdifita adi tokaiwabu umiyami be higa vita tulina tulina ganavele-ma agaidiya yaku faiwala ganaseyemaunena, kadu fafali moyaꞋaina kalivai-dina valeya hinanogali-yo Iya Yaubada aku egana hinahalamanena faꞋina.

content: Yaubada hidedemi gigahe faꞋina kahalamanena gaveyao Bana nuwanuwana ginahinekalikaliyedi medema ginahinekalikaliyedi, ada gaveyao Bana nuwanuwana tagadi ginaꞋivekuluna medema tagadi ginaꞋivekuluna.
Folo Yaubada yana ilaꞋa kadu yana hinekalikali
faꞋina gilukahihi.

Tu kaliva saꞋeyana agaimiya ginatoliyeku ginagayo, “KaꞋi Yaubada kaliva tufoidi tagadi giꞋivekuluna, gavadi-yo yadi koyona faꞋina gidakeyedi? KaꞋi tagakulu amine hinahuluva, au Yaubada yana nuwanuwa amine hinahuluva faꞋina Bana Tauna tagadi giꞋivekuluna.”

Ada iya bonana ganafatana ganagayo, “Kumani, o vaita hakwaꞋadi yo Yaubada uꞋawafaseni?” WaꞋita, keke gidalubodani be avaeka ana toꞋaibubuna againe ginaꞋawafata ginagayo, Gavadi-yo hidede amine ububuku?

Mena maikawa ma toꞋaibubuna yana abavehimeya. KaꞋi nuwanuwana digo, anafaiweya maikawa ana monuna saꞋeyana againe avaeka luhei ginabubudi, saꞋeyana ana wavaigau aꞋa ana abavetagova faꞋina, saꞋeyana avaeka-kawowo yogo ana abavedodoga faꞋina.

Yaubada anafaiweya avaeka ana toꞋaibubuna. Bana kaliva gibubuda. Kaliva tufoidi yana ilaꞋa guwana hinanuhagana, ada Tauna yana nuwenuweya gihawahegedi be agolaufofola ana eda againe hinanauna. Atu badi agaidiya keke gidamadulaufata au giꞋatuvefaꞋiledi. KaꞋi Yaubada nuwanuwana hidede amine ginahuluva be higa yana ilaꞋa ginaseyemaunena kadu yana faiwala ginaꞋivemogatalina, au keke gidalubodami be wanaꞋawafaseni.

Meda kaliva tufoidi yana hinekalikali hinanuhagana, ada Tauna yana nuwenuweya givegide-vagahidi be kaiwabu ana eda againe hinanauna. Kadu gavadi-yo badi yana ilaꞋa guwana hinanuhagana-ma giꞋatuvefaꞋiledi? Me higa badi yana hinekalikali hinavaina-ma badi kalivai-dina adi agolaufofola hinaꞋita-yo hinagayo, “Yaubada yana kaiwabu gavatubuga!” Au hidede amine Yaubada yana kaiwabu badi agaidiya ginaꞋivemogatalina. Ada badi kalivai-dina ideꞋeyao Yaubada gikovada-ma kalivai-dana. Tufoida Isileli ana yoꞋo agaidiya katubuyemu tu tufoida yoꞋo tulidiyao agaidiya katubuyemu.

Ada Yaubada kadu omi yoꞋo tulimiyao kalivai-mina gikovami ma bonana ana toꞋawatalatalaina ana egana Hoseya giꞋalakakila. Tuwaina Hoseya Yaubada yana gahe omi yoꞋo tulimiyao kalivai-mina faꞋimiya giꞋetoladina be Veyao Tuwaina ana bukiya gidadauda gigayo,

content.text: Badi keke yaku yoꞋo miIsileli kalivai-dina ma ganakovadi ganagayo, “Omi yaku yoꞋo.”
Mena yoꞋo boi keke nuwanuwaku ma ganagahedi ganagayo, “Nuwanuwaku omiꞋiyao.”
Ada fafali-nadi againe boi gagahedi gagayo,

content: KaduꞋe Yaubada bonana ana toꞋawatalatalaina ana egana Aiseya miIsileli tufoidi faꞋidiya yana buki againe gigahe gigayo,

content.text: MiIsileli yadi yoꞋo kalivai-dina moyaꞋai-moꞋedi taliya ana makama amine. MoyaꞋai-moꞋedi nonogana keke moyaꞋaidi au tufoidiga adi kibababala hinanuhagana. FaꞋina Kaiwabu agaidiya babiya ginamadulaufata, e ginalaufata-vagata.

content: Meda anafaiweya boi Aiseya ahe gigaheye-vagahina gigayo,

content.text: KaꞋi Kaiwabu Tofaiwala-moꞋa ada hilafa tufoidi agaideya keke gidahawahegedi digo, badi miSodoma kadu miGomola hiꞋalika-Ꞌowoga amine meda ide moyaꞋaida kadaꞋalika-Ꞌowoga.

content: Hidede amine Aiseya yana gahe Veyao Tuwaina ana bukiya gidadauda.
MiIsileli keke Yesu Keliso hidavetumaganeni au
yadi dibumuhiga againe hiluluveꞋavina.

Hida ada gahe ana nuwanuwa hidede amine. Badi yoꞋo tulidiyao kalivai-dina yadi yegayega Yaubada matane keke hidanuwenuweni lakahina tu Yaubada againe hivetumagana faꞋina, Bana gisedi yegayegadiyao Bana matane.
Atu badi miIsileli Mosese yana vehimeya ana dibumuhiga hinuwenuwena lakahina, higa vaita medema faꞋina Yaubada gidasedi yegayegadiyao Bana matane. Tu yadi yegayega faꞋina higa-wayoga.
Gavadi-yo yadi yegayega faꞋina higa-wayoga? Me keke yadi vetumagana Yaubada againe hidaseni, au vehimeya ana dibumuhiga againe hiluluveꞋavina vaita medema againe hinayegayega Yaubada matane.

Bana Yesu Keliso yada yegayega ana eda tu Yesu hikilowena faꞋina Bana vaita ogola eda gilubodana-ma againe hitutumadumadu. Mena ogolai-nadi higa Yesu faꞋine Yaubada Veyao Tuwaina ana bukiya gigahe gigayo,

content.text: Tu hai kaliva Bana againe ginavetumagana,

content: Au hidedemi Yaubada Yesu faꞋine gigahe.
